conclusion: No reliable transferable improvement or matched published-protocol superiority established
caveats: Previously examined labels; paired target-specific exploratory intervals included zero
Repeated task frames are not independent scientific cohorts
Mixed label cutoff conventions and different published protocols
Clinical site recovery is not potency; small MYC/immune cohorts are not robust validation
